name: empty_object
description: The empty object is the base case: no keys, no whitespace, `{}`.

name: empty_array
description: The empty array hashes distinctly from the empty object.

name: nested_scrambled_keys
description: Keys are written here out of order at every level. Sorting is part of the canonical form, so re-ordering this input must not move the digest.

input.alpha: first by value, last by position
input.Alpha: capitals sort before lowercase by code point

name: unicode_text
description: Non-ASCII text hashes as UTF-8 characters, not as \uXXXX escapes (ensure_ascii=False). Astral characters included on purpose.

input.thai: สวัสดีชาวโลก

name: integer_one
description: An integer stays an integer: serializes as `1`.

name: float_one
description: A float stays a float: serializes as `1.0`. This is a DIFFERENT input from integer_one and must hash differently.

name: float_shortest_roundtrip
description: Floats use the shortest round-trip form: 0.1 is `0.1`.

name: large_integer
description: A big integer is not coerced to a float and keeps every digit.

name: decimal_as_string
description: A Decimal serializes as its exact string, trailing zeros included: Decimal('1.50') is "1.50" and is deliberately distinct from '1.5'.

name: datetime_offset_normalises_to_z
description: A +02:00 timestamp is converted to UTC and spelled with a literal Z. Its digest equals datetime_already_utc, which names the same instant.

name: datetime_already_utc
description: The same instant written as UTC. Same digest as datetime_offset_normalises_to_z.

name: null_kept
description: None is a value, not an absence: {"a": null} does not collide with {}.

name: booleans_and_nesting
description: Booleans stay JSON booleans; arrays keep their order.

name: bogus_content_hash_excluded
description: The top-level content_hash is omitted from its own input. This payload carries obvious garbage there; the digest is that of the same payload without the field, so replacing the garbage cannot move it.

name: nested_content_hash_retained
description: Only the TOP-LEVEL content_hash is excluded. A nested reference's digest is part of what the outer contract commits to and stays in the input.

name: model_datetime_offset_normalises_to_z
description: A pydantic model carrying a +02:00 timestamp. The model path applies the same datetime rule as a plain dict: the offset is converted to UTC and spelled with a literal Z. Same digest as model_equivalent_plain_dict, which holds the identical value with no model around it.

name: model_equivalent_plain_dict
description: The fields of model_datetime_offset_normalises_to_z as a bare dict, defaults written out. Its digest must equal that vector's: canonicalization is a property of the value, not of the Python type it arrived in.

name: model_artifact_ref_path
description: A real contract from the package root. Pins two rules through the model path: a Path serializes as its string (non-ASCII included, unescaped) and an unset optional stays null rather than being dropped.

name: astral_key_sort_order
description: Keys sort by Unicode code point (U+FF7D before U+1F600), which is Python's native order; a JCS/RFC 8785 sorter orders by UTF-16 code unit and would emit the emoji first. The TypeScript twin must sort this way.
